boundaries: The discussion question reports 775 MB installed and 312 MB DMG; Leo’s reply states a future next-release target of 248/266 MB installed and 79/93 MB DMGs from a 298 MB comparison.
PR 19255’s signed dry run is an intermediate receipt: universal 741.8 MiB/238.9 MB, arm64 461.3 MiB/145.0 MB, x86_64 481.9 MiB/160.8 MB. It is not the discussion target.

All component claims are non-additive. Main and feat-cmux-next counterparts, architecture variants, and overlapping payload/string/LTO layers stay separate. No app download reduction is inferred from installed or component deltas.
PR 16732 preserves a negative result: the first CEF locale allowlist over-pruned regional catalogs, so its 36.46 MiB expectation was corrected to about 34.5 MiB without a second fleet build.
hashMethod: SHA-256 over primary PR API body strings captured 2026-10-15; the 19733 post-merge measurement comment is separately hashed and is authoritative for that published result.
